agent.problem: Multiple choice dominates both stops by a wide margin: 7 of 9 choice cards in stop 1 and 9 of 11 in stop 2. Neither stop uses a fill-in-the-blank card.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

agent.problem: The question is not self-contained. In "Once they know it was Samson," the word "it" depends on the preceding story card for what Samson did; the question itself never mentions his burning the Philistines' crops.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

agent.problem: This story card has three sentences. Only the walkthrough's opening card may be that long; this is the opening of the second stop, not the opening card of the walkthrough.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: "That place" has no antecedent within the question. Identifying the place where Samson fought requires earlier cards that are no longer on screen.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

human.problem: Samson is never introduced, for example as Israel's judge. Neither are the Philistines when they first come up in card 5. The baker is never told that his wife's family are Philistines either. This passage is passage 3 of 5 in the Samson story group, so bakers may already have met them in earlier passages.
